repositories.title: HexaBee-4B
repositories.subtitle: Six languages. One translator.
repositories.description: The final merged **HexaBee-4B** translator based on Gemma 3 4B IT. Adaptation combines Wikipedia continued pretraining, multilingual answering with answer-text translation, and a final fresh LoRA trained on bidirectional synthetic translations. The six evaluation languages are Persian, English, Arabic, Chinese, Hebrew and Spanish.
repositories.contents: Full two-shard Safetensors weights, Gemma 3 processor/tokenizer and chat template. No adapter merge is required for this repository.
repositories.provenance: The final model was trained with a fresh rank-256 LoRA (alpha 512, dropout 0.005) on the already-merged multilingual checkpoint. The final stage retained 658,274 SFT records: 329,137 aligned pairs in both orientations. It ran one epoch with learning rate 1e-4 and cutoff 4,096. All weights are preserved; only local path metadata is normalized for publication.
repositories.limitations: The released checkpoint has not been evaluated for image tasks, despite retaining the Gemma 3 multimodal architecture. Intermediate checkpoints have no independent matched translation evaluation. Quality can vary by language, domain, and input length.

repositories.description: Merged checkpoint after the multilingual answering and answer-text translation stage. This is the **required base of the final translation adapter**; it is an intermediate checkpoint, not the evaluated final HexaBee-4B translator.
repositories.contents: Full two-shard Safetensors weights, Gemma 3 configuration, processor/tokenizer, and chat template. This merged checkpoint is the exact base for the final translation LoRA.
repositories.provenance: Wikipedia adapter → continued multilingual SFT adapter → merge with Gemma 3 4B IT. Phase 2 used all 22 retained SFT datasets, totalling 30,153,404 records. No independent translation evaluation of this intermediate checkpoint is available.
repositories.limitations: The released checkpoint has not been evaluated for image tasks, despite retaining the Gemma 3 multimodal architecture. Intermediate checkpoints have no independent matched translation evaluation. Quality can vary by language, domain, and input length.

repositories.title: HexaBee · Wikipedia Foundations
repositories.subtitle: Wikipedia text, organized by language.
repositories.description: Raw Wikipedia text sources registered for the executed continued-pretraining stage. The Persian source was registered four times in the historical mixture; this release stores it once and documents the sampling multiplicity.
repositories.contents: One Parquet configuration per unique registered source: Persian, English, Arabic, Chinese, and Egyptian Arabic. Each record contains `id`, `text`, and `language`. These are raw rows, not packed training sequences.
repositories.provenance: The executed PT adapter card lists wiki-en, fawiki1, wiki-ar, fawiki2, wiki-zh, fawiki3, wiki-arz, fawiki4. The four fawiki registrations reference the same file. The trainer reported 3,399,664 training examples after preprocessing; raw source counts measured below are a different unit. Original article revisions and historical source hashes were not captured. The five PT sources differ from the six translation-evaluation languages.
repositories.limitations: Historical exports may contain empty strings, imperfect generated text and instruction conflicts. Source row reuse is not independent evidence. See measured release statistics and the accompanying evaluation scope.

repositories.title: HexaBee · Multilingual Answering & Translation
repositories.subtitle: Ask in one language. Answer in another.
repositories.description: The exact 22 final SFT exports used in phase 2: **19,458,332 answering records**, including **5,759,806 cross-language QA records**, plus **10,695,072 answer-text translations**. The question language and requested answer language can differ; answering a question is distinct from translating its wording.
repositories.contents: 22 configurations named by neutral source group and task. `system`, `instruct`, `output` are original training strings. Component/task metadata and unique positional content hashes are added. Per-row language labels were stripped in the final original exports and are null here, rather than guessed.
repositories.provenance: The corpus derives from 2,025,730 source rows expanded by language and style. Gemma 3 27B IT produced Persian→English/Arabic and English→Chinese/Hebrew/Spanish variants. The stage used all six answer-translation groups plus complete, moderate, formal and informal answering exports. The 329 construction components combine into 22 final files. 1,961 complete-answer records have known language-directive conflicts; complete QA covers 27 cross-language directions.
repositories.limitations: Historical exports may contain empty strings, imperfect generated text and instruction conflicts. Source row reuse is not independent evidence. See measured release statistics and the accompanying evaluation scope.

repositories.title: HexaBee · Bidirectional Translation
repositories.subtitle: Aligned meaning. Both directions.
repositories.description: The independently generated synthetic translation corpus and the final forward/reverse SFT data. Includes the original held-out translation test split and the original train split without creating a new split.
repositories.contents: `aligned_pairs`: 329,146 train and 36,572 test pairs. `forward_sft` and `reverse_sft`: 329,137 training rows each. Together the latter two configurations are the 658,274 final SFT examples. Pair rows and SFT rows are distinct views of overlapping content; their counts must not be interpreted as independent examples.
repositories.provenance: Native source generation metadata identifies DeepSeek-V3.1. Translation generation uses the service alias deepseek-chat, without an immutable backend revision for every call. The historical split was unseeded; these stored memberships are preserved. Nine train pairs were removed before reversal. Reverse examples swap aligned texts and do not constitute model-generated back-translation.
repositories.limitations: Historical exports may contain empty strings, imperfect generated text and instruction conflicts. Source row reuse is not independent evidence. See measured release statistics and the accompanying evaluation scope.

repositories.title: HexaBee · The Prompt Hive
repositories.subtitle: Language, style, and translation instructions.
repositories.description: Original system-instruction pools for response language, answer extent, style, and translation directions. **341,142 imported rows** are preserved, including duplicate paraphrases with their historical sampling mass.
repositories.contents: Normalized fields: `id`, `component`, `language` (instruction wording), optional `source` and `target`, and `text`. Six components: language, complete, moderate, formal, informal and translate. This is the full imported inventory, not the 36 illustrative seeds in the code demo.
repositories.provenance: Original *_combined.json prompt files were imported with their directional metadata. Hidden notebook checkpoint copies were ignored. Translation filenames encode wording/source/target languages; answering filenames encode wording/target. Duplicate real pool rows are retained. Pool lengths are measured on these archived files, not inferred from requested paraphrase counts.
repositories.limitations: Historical exports may contain empty strings, imperfect generated text and instruction conflicts. Source row reuse is not independent evidence. See measured release statistics and the accompanying evaluation scope.

repositories.title: HexaBee · Translation Archive
repositories.subtitle: Every stored prediction, independently inspectable.
repositories.description: Stored candidate translations from HexaBee-4B and the public Gemma 3 4B/12B IT baselines. Full-test predictions and the matched judged subset remain distinct configurations.
repositories.scope: Raw model predictions and judge responses
repositories.contents: For each model: a full-test configuration (36,572 rows) and a judged configuration (300 rows). Fields preserve source/reference strings and the candidate; null candidates become empty strings. Judged configurations additionally preserve both raw judge objects as JSON strings, including the original raw response for reparsing valid zero scores.
repositories.provenance: All model files refer to the same stored source/reference identities; automatic evaluation checks strict identity pairing. The matched judge subset has ten examples in each of 30 directions. Archived inference templates differ between models; the outputs are not claimed to be a controlled equal-prompt comparison. PCT-4B is renamed HexaBee-4B only at the model-label level.
repositories.limitations: Historical exports may contain empty strings, imperfect generated text and instruction conflicts. Source row reuse is not independent evidence. See measured release statistics and the accompanying evaluation scope.

repositories.title: HexaBee · Evaluation Atlas
repositories.subtitle: Thirty directions. Three systems. Traceable evidence.
repositories.description: All translation directions, automatic metrics, eight-dimension model judging, paired bootstrap intervals, and the data-composition audit in one independently downloadable evaluation repository.
repositories.contents: `all_direction_metrics.csv`: 90 system/direction rows with BLEU, chrF, chrF++, TER, COMET, judge means and all eight rubric dimensions in both modes. `paired_scores.csv`: 900 score-only rows for paired intervals. Additional JSON files contain metric signatures, sufficient statistics, COMET checkpoint provenance, and audited phase-2 data counts. Figures are included in PNG, SVG and PDF formats. The expandable tables below compare all models separately for each target language.
repositories.provenance: Full test: 36,572 examples per model. Judge subset: 300 matched examples per model, ten per direction. SacreBLEU 2.5.1; BLEU zh tokenizer for Chinese targets and 13a otherwise; chrF character order 6; chrF++ word order 2; TER normalized with Asian support; unbabel-comet 2.2.7 and wmt22-comet-da (512-position encoder). Judge intervals use 10,000 paired direction-stratified bootstrap replicates and seed 20260912. Zero scores were recovered from raw responses rather than discarded.
repositories.limitations: Historical exports may contain empty strings, imperfect generated text and instruction conflicts. Source row reuse is not independent evidence. See measured release statistics and the accompanying evaluation scope.
